ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

basic.note: Editable launch columns with a computed total; Enter or double-click a cell to edit.

record-grid.description: Launch sheet with sections, merged cells, and controlled editing with internal commit.

editing.note: Values must stay between 0 and 10; every commit lands in the log below the grid.

examples.note: Start with the default record grid, then explore sections, merging, and editing below.

formulas.note: Total and final columns react to edits; final weights total twice against project.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

layout.note: Auto sizes columns to content. Card collapses rows into consolidated fields.

merging.note: The shift cell spans its section rows and filled notes span the project column.

sections.note: Morning and evening shifts render as section dividers with per-group footer averages.

record-grid.title: Record grid
